parameter.name: limit
parameter.label: Limit
parameter.description: The maximum number of playlists to return

parameter.name: offset
parameter.label: Offset
parameter.description: The index of the first playlist to return

parameter.name: imageIndex
parameter.label: Image Index
parameter.description: Index in the list to select the image to show

parameter.name: forceHttps
parameter.label: Force HTTPS
parameter.description: Always use https for the Spotify redirect URI, regardless of the scheme openHAB detects for the incoming request. Enable this when running behind a reverse proxy that terminates https but does not identify itself through a recognized forwarded-proto header, causing the redirect URI to incorrectly use http.
